model_contract.output_description: Softmax probabilities summing to 1.0 in class order: index 0=Fresh, index 1=Moderate, index 2=Spoiled

Fruits.note: Only binary Fresh/Spoiled labels exist in this dataset. No genuine Moderate class available for Fruits.

Vegetables.note: Only binary Fresh/Spoiled labels exist in this dataset. No genuine Moderate class available for Vegetables.

Meat.note: Three-class dataset. Original label 'Half_Fresh' is mapped to 'Moderate'. This is the primary source for the Moderate class.

Dairy.note: No suitable public freshness-labelled dairy dataset found. Dairy is NOT supported in the current model.

moderate_class_source.note: Moderate class is populated from genuine 'Half_Fresh' meat images. No synthetic augmentation is used to create any class.

honest_limitations: Moderate class images come exclusively from Meat data (Half_Fresh label). The Moderate class does not represent Moderate Fruits or Moderate Vegetables.
Dairy category is not supported — no public freshness-labelled dairy dataset was found.
Fruits and Vegetables training data is binary (Fresh/Spoiled). The model may not reliably classify moderately fresh fruits or vegetables.
If Fruits or Vegetables are submitted for inference and classified as Moderate, that prediction is based on meat-derived Moderate features.

rejected_datasets.name: Fruits 360
rejected_datasets.reason: Food-type recognition dataset, not freshness dataset. All images are fresh fruit on white backgrounds. Labels are fruit variety, not freshness state.
